snippet.title: We Will Be Gods - Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
We Will Be Gods is a free-to-play strategy war game on a massive scale. Large kingdoms of players must work together to face-off against other player-owned kingdoms, battling it out in massive, months-long wars in a bid to attain godhood and ultimate victory. 

You will be transported to the world of Hamarvast, a land shaped by the gods Thornir and Glimra. Once a calm and peaceful realm, it is now in turmoil and the cosmic balance is disrupted by dark forces. As a mortal champion, can you ascend to grasp the power of the gods and bring victory to your kingdom, or will you just become a fading memory?

Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/dSwnMvy9J2
Sign-up for Alpha: https://www.wewillbegods.com/prealpha
Follow us on X: https://x.com/WeWillBeGods_
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493410/We_Will_Be_Gods/
Website: https://www.wewillbegods.com/
